name: Knowledge Vault Tools
description: Provider-independent knowledge ingestion, extraction, semantic index maintenance, retrieval evaluation, auditing and rebuilding over the configured Vault.
author: Ariadne Core

hardware_requirements.gpu: Configured Rust Host profile for the selected ingestion operation

health.detail: Uses the configured Knowledge Vault storage, maintained v2 workers and existing MCP service.

workspace.startup: Explicit user action opens the workspace and requests Rust Host admission.
workspace.readiness: Enable model-backed operations only after the Rust Host model and GPU leases are admitted.
workspace.shutdown: Stop new jobs, checkpoint active ingestion, release Rust Host leases and restore Ariadne.
workspace.recovery: Session heartbeat expiry closes abandoned sessions; ingest workers retain their checkpoint contract.
